n950bb9852ae.s: Which of the following committees is correctly matched with its period and chairperson?
o: Committee on Panchayati Raj Finances (1963) – John Matthai
Local Finance Enquiry Committee (1949-51) – P.K. Wattal
n950bb9852ae.x: The Local Finance Enquiry Committee (1949-51) was headed by P.K. Wattal. John Matthai chaired the Taxation Enquiry Commission, K. Santhanam the Committee on Panchayati Raj Finances and A.P. Jain the Rural-Urban Relationship Committee.

n815ace0f60f.s: The weak revenue position of municipalities is mainly due to chronic under-assessment and under-collection of:
n815ace0f60f.x: Municipal finances are weakened particularly by chronic under-assessment and under-collection of property tax.

nd45ab17e411.s: Which was an entry condition for urban local bodies to receive the relevant Fifteenth Finance Commission grants?
o: Issue of municipal bonds by every town
Transfer of land-revenue powers to municipalities
Publication of audited accounts and notification of baseline property-tax rates
Levy of professional tax at the maximum permitted rate
nd45ab17e411.x: ULBs had to publish audited accounts and notify baseline property-tax rates to become eligible for the grants.

ndb1b0f602e4.s: Delayed local-body elections in Andhra Pradesh put Finance Commission grants at risk because the grants are linked to:
o: Access of municipalities to the bond market
Appointment of Special Officers to run the bodies
Elected bodies, audited accounts and compliance with State Finance Commission requirements
ndb1b0f602e4.x: The grants are tied to the existence of elected bodies, audited accounts and SFC compliance, so delayed elections jeopardise eligibility and release.

n29cccb42682.s: India's intergovernmental transfers are about ____ of GDP, against a global norm of about ____.
n29cccb42682.x: India's intergovernmental transfers are about 0.5% of GDP, compared with a global norm of roughly 2–5% of GDP.

nf2d5fc17a92.s: Government expenditure that creates an asset or reduces a liability is classified as:
nf2d5fc17a92.x: Capital expenditure either creates assets or reduces liabilities; revenue expenditure generally does neither.

n34e04d0afb6.s: The 'Golden Rule' of public finance says government borrowing should ordinarily be used for:
o: Creation of assets through capital expenditure
n34e04d0afb6.x: The Golden Rule allows borrowing only for asset creation, so the quality and composition of spending matter more than its size.

n6030b0b965b.s: Which fertiliser remains outside the Nutrient Based Subsidy scheme?
n6030b0b965b.x: NBS covers 22 grades of decontrolled P&K fertilisers including DAP, MOP and SSP, with subsidy fixed per kg of nutrient; urea is outside the scheme.

n72e30568b67.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
n72e30568b67.x: The Expenditure Reforms Commission was set up in February 2000 under K.P. Geethakrishnan; the Expenditure Management Commission (2014) was chaired by Bimal Jalan.

nindian-economy-62-17.s: Which pair consists only of instruments of internal debt?
nindian-economy-62-17.x: G-Secs and Treasury Bills are internal-debt instruments; external assistance and foreign borrowings are external debt.

n908a0b7f965.s: Market borrowings are the largest source of the government's:
n908a0b7f965.x: Market borrowings are the biggest source of the government's capital receipts.

n70f6a135536.s: A zero primary deficit means that fresh government borrowing is needed only to meet:
n70f6a135536.x: Primary deficit excludes interest payments; when it is zero, fresh borrowing covers only interest.

n257de072aec.s: Public debt has become a fiscal anchor mainly because high interest payments:
o: Squeeze expenditure on other public purposes
Expand fiscal space for capital expenditure
n257de072aec.x: Interest payments of about 40% of revenue receipts constrain fiscal space and squeeze other spending.

n1cef88bdae9.s: The main concern about State off-budget borrowings and guarantees is that they:
o: Make consolidated public debt appear lower than it actually is
n1cef88bdae9.x: Off-budget borrowings and guarantees conceal the true consolidated debt burden and may weigh on sovereign ratings.

n94d6152caec.s: The 16th Finance Commission recommended that off-budget borrowing should be:
o: Stopped, with existing off-budget debt brought on-budget
n94d6152caec.x: The 16th FC recommended stopping off-budget borrowing, bringing existing debt on-budget and widening the definitions of deficit and debt.

nindian-economy-59-6.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Government must repay or use money in the Public Account of India according to applicable rules.
2. The Contingency Fund of India is the main account into which government revenues are credited.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-economy-59-6.x: Public Account money is held in trust and repaid or used by rule. The main government account is the Consolidated Fund, not the Contingency Fund.

nindian-economy-59-12.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Contingency Fund of India – Money held by Government in trust
National Investment Fund – Urgent or unforeseen expenditure
Public Account of India – Money held by Government in trust
Consolidated Fund of India – Corpus intended to be permanent
nindian-economy-59-12.x: The Public Account holds money in trust. The Consolidated Fund is the main account, the Contingency Fund meets urgent needs and the NIF has a permanent corpus.

ncdbd6a3ebd2.s: In India, deficit financing was used as a pragmatic tool mainly to finance:
ncdbd6a3ebd2.x: Deficit financing mobilised resources for economic development and financed the Five Year Plans.

n23516ca5af1.s: The fiscal multiplier is generally largest for:
n23516ca5af1.x: Capital expenditure has a larger multiplier than revenue spending or transfers because it creates productive capacity and draws in complementary investment.

n9312c5979f5.x: AP still runs a primary deficit, so it has a fiscal deficit even after excluding interest payments.

nba0c257f7e3.s: Under the FY 2021-22 glide path, the Union fiscal deficit was to be brought below what share of GDP by 2025-26?
nba0c257f7e3.x: The commitment was below 4.5% of GDP by 2025-26 (met at 4.4%); from 2026-27 the fiscal deficit is calibrated each year to keep the debt-GDP ratio falling.

n849b66623f7.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Contractionary fiscal stance – Used during recession
Expansionary fiscal stance – Used during recession
Neutral fiscal stance – Used to address overheating
Expansionary fiscal stance – Balanced effect on demand
n849b66623f7.x: Expansionary policy supports the economy in recession; contractionary policy addresses overheating and a neutral stance has a balanced effect on demand.

n4fe34bc2db9.s: The largest fertiliser subsidy item in India is:
n4fe34bc2db9.x: Urea is the largest fertiliser subsidy item.

n90e858f0e7e.s: Which of the following FRBM statements is correctly matched with its content?
o: Medium-Term Fiscal Policy Statement – Three-year expenditure projections
Macro-Economic Framework Statement – Growth, inflation, external balance, assumptions and risks
Fiscal Policy Strategy Statement – Three-year rolling fiscal targets
Medium-Term Expenditure Framework Statement – Taxation, borrowing and debt strategy
n90e858f0e7e.x: The Macro-Economic Framework Statement covers macroeconomic prospects and risks; the MTFP Statement gives rolling targets, the FPS Statement sets fiscal strategy and the MTEF Statement gives expenditure projections.

n279e7e8dca4.s: From which year were the FRBM three-year rolling fiscal targets suspended to give post-pandemic flexibility?
n279e7e8dca4.x: The three-year rolling targets were suspended from 2021-22 to provide flexibility in the post-pandemic period.

n4089495541e.s: The fiscal responsibility limits under the Andhra Pradesh FRBM framework mainly restrain the State's:
n4089495541e.x: AP's FRBM limits impose fiscal and borrowing discipline, restraining its open-market borrowing.

n7413ef7157e.s: The Fiscal Council recommended by the N.K. Singh Committee was envisaged as:
o: A department of the Reserve Bank of India
A committee of Parliament with executive powers
A body with binding powers over the Budget
n7413ef7157e.x: The proposed Fiscal Council was an independent, advisory institution without binding executive or judicial powers.

n0cc2aee75f1.s: Through the FRBM deviation statement, the Government has formally acknowledged deviation from which targets of the Act?
n0cc2aee75f1.x: The Government has acknowledged deviation from the Act's 3% fiscal-deficit and 40% Central-debt targets.

n4d849b378f6.s: The FRBM escape clause can be triggered when real output growth falls ____ percentage points below the average of the previous four quarters.
n4d849b378f6.x: One escape-clause trigger is a fall in real output growth by 3 percentage points below the average of the previous four quarters.

n9b42ac3f86b.s: In which year was the Andhra Pradesh Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act enacted?
n9b42ac3f86b.x: The AP FRBM Act was enacted in 2005; it aims to eliminate the revenue deficit and limit the fiscal deficit to 3% of GSDP.

na021062915e.s: The main significance of the FRBM framework is that it:
o: Made fiscal discipline a legal duty and added disclosure statements to the Budget
Gave the Finance Commission control over Union borrowing
na021062915e.x: The FRBM framework gave fiscal discipline a legal basis and made disclosure statements part of the Budget process.

n9e230031cbf.s: A full statement of receipts and expenditure presented by an outgoing government in an election year is called:
n9e230031cbf.x: An interim budget is a full statement of receipts and expenditure by an outgoing government; a vote on account only authorises expenditure for part of the year.

n650854ac98f.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Performance budget – Expenditure without reference to results
Outcome budget – Control over individual items of expenditure
Line-item budget – Traditional control over individual items of expenditure
Zero-based budget – Traditional control over individual items of expenditure
n650854ac98f.x: A line-item budget is the traditional budget focused on control over individual items of expenditure.

ne544b969420.s: Which of the following is charged on the Consolidated Fund of India?
ne544b969420.x: Salaries, allowances and pensions of Supreme Court judges, and pensions of High Court judges, are charged on the Consolidated Fund of India.

n6888538a4ac.s: Budget 2026-27, which continued fiscal consolidation without big tax cuts, estimated the Union fiscal deficit at:
n6888538a4ac.x: Budget 2026-27 kept to fiscal consolidation with a 4.3% fiscal-deficit estimate and a debt-GDP path, without large tax cuts.

n93b6c05bc48.s: Which of the following is an example of capital expenditure?
n93b6c05bc48.x: Capital expenditure creates assets or reduces liabilities; examples include capital works, loans given and debt repayment.

nindian-economy-32-4.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Interest receipts – Capital receipt that creates a liability
Borrowings – Capital receipt that reduces assets
Disinvestment – Capital receipt that reduces assets
nindian-economy-32-4.x: Disinvestment is a capital receipt that reduces assets; borrowings create a liability, interest receipts are non-tax revenue and tax revenue comes from compulsory levies.

n3fcaef4b5e3.s: The Halwa ceremony in the Union Budget process marks the:
n3fcaef4b5e3.x: The Halwa ceremony marks the printing of the Budget documents; the Budget circular is issued earlier, in September.

ne433f67ba3e.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
ne433f67ba3e.x: UBI featured in the 2016-17 Survey; the Chakravyuha challenge was 2015-16, Thalinomics 2019-20 and the Bare Necessities Index 2020-21.

n49cf62090f3.s:
Arrange the following sectors in ascending order of their projected FY26 growth rates:
A. Services
B. Agriculture
C. Manufacturing
n49cf62090f3.x: Agriculture 3.1%, manufacturing 7.0% and services 9.1%, so the ascending order is B, C, A.

nfe1b5f439a9.s: National Accounts and the Index of Industrial Production were rebased to which base year, as reported in the Economic Survey 2025-26?
nfe1b5f439a9.x: National Accounts and the IIP were rebased to 2022-23, with release scheduled for February 2026.

n83b0b84811c.s: After bifurcation, the share of which sector in Andhra Pradesh's economy rose because Hyderabad-centred services and industry went to Telangana?
n83b0b84811c.x: With Hyderabad-centred services and industry going to Telangana, agriculture's share in AP rose and industry's share fell.

nbf339d40e13.s: The GSDP growth rate of Andhra Pradesh in 2016-17 was:
nbf339d40e13.x: The APPSC-GS 2023 matching key recorded 11.61% as AP's GSDP growth rate in 2016-17.

n64cb57e0a7a.s: The share of agriculture : industry : services in Andhra Pradesh's GSVA in 2025-26 FAE (current prices) was about:
n64cb57e0a7a.x: In 2025-26 FAE at current prices, agriculture and allied was about 33%, industry 24% and services 43%.

n5d926d7ce0c.s: Andhra Pradesh's agriculture and allied sector recorded its peak growth in 2017-18 of:
n5d926d7ce0c.x: Peak agriculture and allied growth was 18.23% in 2017-18; 30% growth over five years was the target.

ndf22f5e42c9.s: Which services sub-sector recorded the highest growth in Andhra Pradesh in 2025-26 FAE?
ndf22f5e42c9.x: Communications recorded the highest growth among the services sub-sectors, at 15.13%.

n642ed3e4cf2.s: The GSDP of Andhra Pradesh in 2022-23 at current prices was:
n642ed3e4cf2.x: The APPSC-GS 2023 key gave AP's 2022-23 GSDP at current prices as ₹13,38,575 crore.

ncf82226e614.s: Services accounted for about what share of Andhra Pradesh's GVA at current prices in 2021-22?
ncf82226e614.x: Services accounted for about 42% of AP's GVA at current prices in 2021-22.

n14e4f9edc5b.s: Which was the fastest-growing sub-sector of Andhra Pradesh's agriculture and allied sector in 2025-26 FAE?
n14e4f9edc5b.x: Fishing and aquaculture grew fastest within agriculture and allied activities, at 17.69%.

nb2d920d704b.s: In which year did Andhra Pradesh's mining sub-sector record its lowest growth of -26.5%?
nb2d920d704b.x: Mining recorded its lowest growth, -26.5%, in 2020-21; electricity's record high of 37.27% was in 2019-20.

n5986c37487a.s: Which Andhra Pradesh city leads in bank branches and mobile connections and hosts Google data centre, TCS and Cognizant facilities?
n5986c37487a.x: Visakhapatnam leads in bank branches and mobile connections and hosts Google data centre, TCS and Cognizant.

nef55c417ff0.s: Under Sunrise Andhra Pradesh Vision 2029, which goal is correctly matched with its target year?
nef55c417ff0.x: The staged goals were: among the top three States by 2022, the best State by 2029 and the most preferred global investment destination by 2050.

n78ef3f48589.s: Under Swarna Andhra Vision 2047, which year is correctly matched with its GSDP figure?
n78ef3f48589.x: The 2024-25 base GSDP is ₹15.91 lakh crore; the 2028-29 target is ₹29.29 lakh crore and the 2047-48 target ₹308.11 lakh crore.

n35c6fe34c0b.s: The Visakhapatnam Economic Region, a growth-hub pilot with NITI Aayog, covers how many districts?
n35c6fe34c0b.x: VER covers 10 districts and targets a $750-800 billion economy by 2047; nine districts is the Amaravati Economic Region.

n865019f5287.s:
Assertion (A): Andhra Pradesh's GSDP growth can fluctuate significantly with the monsoon.
Reason (R): Agriculture has a high share in Andhra Pradesh's economy.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n865019f5287.x: Both are true, and agriculture's high share makes AP's GSDP sensitive to monsoon conditions.

n169e75cefb1.s: In the latest Andhra Pradesh series, per capita income growth was fastest (15.26%) in:
n169e75cefb1.x: PCI growth was fastest at 15.26% in 2021-22 and slowest at 4.10% in 2019-20.

n5cd6acbd7a9.s: Under the Swarna Andhra objective, the target per capita income by 2047 is approximately:
n5cd6acbd7a9.x: Swarna Andhra envisages per capita income above $42,000 by 2047, about ₹55 lakh; ₹5.43 lakh is the 2028-29 per capita GSDP target.

ndca27c3b837.s: In 2024-25, Telangana's per capita income was about how many times that of Andhra Pradesh?
ndca27c3b837.x: Telangana's PCI was 1.35 times AP's, while its economy was 96.5% of AP's size.

nca0194a082e.s: Regarding ports of Andhra Pradesh, which pair is correctly matched?
nca0194a082e.x: Visakhapatnam is AP's one major port; there are 17 notified non-major ports and four greenfield ports under construction.

n79a74137e58.s: Among the old districts of Andhra Pradesh, which had the highest forest cover?
n79a74137e58.x: Visakhapatnam had the highest forest cover; YSR Kadapa had the largest forest area and Krishna the least.

n6fef1ae2b93.s: Polavaram is declared a national project under which section of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014?
n6fef1ae2b93.x: Polavaram is a national project under Section 90, and Telangana's consent is deemed to have been given.

nde13cbc8b75.s: Which is the largest forest of Andhra Pradesh, home to NSTR, India's largest tiger reserve?
nde13cbc8b75.x: Nallamala is AP's largest forest; NSTR, India's largest tiger reserve, lies in it and is shared with Telangana.

n7542b051fd8.s: How much central assistance was provided for capital buildings of Andhra Pradesh under Section 94(3) of the Reorganisation Act?
n7542b051fd8.x: ₹2,500 crore was given for capital buildings under Section 94(3); ₹3,979 crore was the 2014-15 revenue deficit grant and ₹22,113 crore the 2015-20 post-devolution grants.

na02b9f403a7.s: Under the 16th Finance Commission, which ended revenue deficit grants for all States, Andhra Pradesh's share of the divisible pool rose to:
na02b9f403a7.x: The 16th FC ended revenue deficit grants for all States, and AP's divisible-pool share rose to 4.22%.

nb629930e47a.s: Under Schedule XI of the AP Reorganisation Act, a function of the KRMB and GRMB is:
o: Approving new projects on the Krishna and Godavari
Redetermining the shares of AP and Telangana every water year
Regulating supply from notified headworks according to tribunal awards
Referring water disputes to a tribunal
nb629930e47a.x: The Boards regulate supply from notified headworks as per tribunal awards and release water by State shares; approving projects and referring disputes belong to the Apex Council, and redetermining shares is not their function.

n0c3c55b0c1d.s: Telangana objects to AP's Pothireddypadu Head Regulator/Rayalaseema Lift project on the ground that Srisailam is mainly a:
n0c3c55b0c1d.x: Telangana's objection is that Srisailam is mainly a power project; AP built the scheme on the Krishna.
